merchant.label: Merchant
merchant.description: The leader bargains like a trading companion: 5% off cash purchases; selling prices unchanged.

doctor.label: Doctor
doctor.description: The leader nurses like a caregiving companion: care restores extra health and speeds recovery.

saddler.label: Saddler
saddler.description: The leader works leather like a leatherworking companion: buckskin, leather goods and harness jobs.

hunter.label: Hunter
hunter.description: The leader shoots like a hunting companion: faster reloads on the hunt, skilled hunting outings, and a little better aim in fights.

soldier.label: Soldier
soldier.description: Back from the Mexican War: the leader counts as a Veteran, with less injury risk in confrontations and a steadier death save and a soldier's aim in tactical fights; stock thieves give a soldier's watch a wider berth.

outlaw.label: Outlaw
outlaw.description: The leader has done this before: one prior job counts toward crime experience (still capped), so thefts and robberies go a little smoother. Who notices still depends on the scene.

carpenter.label: Carpenter
carpenter.description: The leader counts as a Carpentry specialist: faster and wooden wagon repairs, and skilled carpentry work where it is offered.

farmer.label: Stockman
farmer.description: Raised with stock and land: the team strains 1 less on hard working days and recovers 1 more on rest days with grass; the leader gathers half again as much when foraging; butchering yields a quarter more meat and never injures the leader; milk cows, goats and hens give a quarter more.

profession_skills_note: Authored game terms. Most 1840s emigrants were farmers who drove their own stock; the edge is skill, not cash or gear. Every skill needs a leader with at least minimum_health and no serious condition.
